title: 第106章 向全场宣战！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 刘州认为他把姿态放到如此低，又是众目睽睽之下，唐逸肯定不敢太过分，会帮着他向皇帝求情。　　毕竟，唐逸不敢得罪刘家！　　唐逸抬头看向刘州，嗯？威胁我？　　老子没穿越前，外军研究老子的资料，都能装满一栋楼了。　　我怕了吗？我还不是杀到他们胆寒？　　更别说你刘家，已经快完蛋了！　　“你不会放过我，你只是不想死而已。”　　唐逸向前走了几步，逼近刘州：“好好享受吧，杖责三十外加饱餐一顿，熬过去……你还能多活几日！”　　他还真不希望刘州就这么死了！　　报仇这种事，他一般喜欢亲自动手。　　而沈园时候之后，就该接手老舅的案子，对刘家父子动手了。　　刘州听到唐逸的话，整个人吓得跌在地上，被锦衣卫拖了下去。　　刘温死死攥着拳头，盯着唐逸的眼睛都红了，仿佛渗着血……该死的，该死的，我儿子求你，那是你的荣幸，你竟敢拒绝！　　你找死，找死！刘文在心头怒吼，却不敢说出半句话。　　刚才，他给唐敬说刘州是年少轻狂，现在他敢和皇帝说同样的话吗？　　他不敢啊！　　错了，就得认。　　他只能将所有的恨和愤怒，算在唐逸身上。　　刘温没说话，全场也没人敢说话。　　唐画被刘州一口一个唐哥地叫着，平时关系莫逆，这时候他也是躲得远远的，脑袋都快藏到裤裆里了。　　生怕刘州向他求救。　　刘州这些世家子弟，对他来说不过是棋子而已。　　既然是棋子，那就随时做好被丢弃的准备。　　再说，能给他唐画当棋子，那是他们的荣幸。　　“刘温，你不用这么看着我，很快，你就会和你儿子团聚的。”　　唐逸看到刘温目光森冷盯着自己，耸耸肩道：“而且，这一天不会太久，不会超过十天，你刘家就该和京都说再见了。”　　众人顿时都错愕看着唐逸，这是直接向户部尚书宣战？　　他一个小小的锦衣卫百户，竟然敢直接和位高权重的户部尚书宣战？他疯了吗？　　炎文帝听到唐逸的话，嘴角的笑容更浓了，真不愧是朕看中的女婿，就这份霸气，嗯，随朕没错了。　　“刘爱卿，这小崽子如此瞧不起你，你怎么说？”　　炎文帝兴致勃勃，闹吧，闹吧，闹得越欢越好。　　你们不闹，朕怎么浑水摸鱼？　　“好，我等着！”刘温死死盯着唐逸，咬牙切齿。　　“行，那朕就给你们做个见证。”　　炎文帝一拍手，当即一手叉腰，一手指着唐逸：“唐逸说了，十日内，让你们这些欠钱不还的家伙，全部乖乖还钱，而且还是连本带利的还。”　　“做不到，他割脑袋以谢天下。”　　“做到了，你们得给他说一声：唐爷，我错了！”　　“你们，可有意见？”　　唐逸猛地抬起头，脸上满是震惊。　　我特妈！　　我没说！　　狗皇帝要害我。　　一群大臣听到这话，也都齐齐看向炎文帝，差点气得跳脚。　　陛下你是真当我们瞎了聋了？唐逸没有说，是你说的吧！　　你这是强行拉仇恨啊！　　呃，不对……很快，回过神的刘温、赵柯等一众大臣眼睛都亮了起来，要知道他们在户部借钱的账簿已经被销毁，根本就不存在了。　　唐逸想要他们十天内还钱，可能吗？根本不可能！　　那这么一想，皇帝这不是将他最爱的小诗仙，送给他们杀吗？　　这么一想，一众大臣顿时都激动起来了。　　“臣等，并无异议。”　　“哼，猖狂小儿，老夫倒是要看看，你到底有啥本事。”　　“陛下放心，臣等定不会让此子猖狂！”　　“……”　　唐逸听着这些杀气腾腾的议论声，脸色黑如锅底。　　想要借我的刀，好歹你也先问我同不同意，不告而取乃是偷……唐逸看向炎文帝，沉声道：“陛下，我有意见！”　　“不，你没意见。”炎文帝摇头。　　“我可以有！”唐逸咬牙切齿。　　“你没有！”炎文帝抬手拍了拍唐逸的肩膀，道：“朕看好你，今日你能以一己之力，碾压全场。”　　“十日内，也能以一己之力，镇压满朝文武。”　　“朕，相信自己的眼光。”　　眼光什么的不重要，主要是朕需要一把刀，来劈开笼罩在大炎上空的阴霾。　　而这把刀，需要朕亲自来磨，所以你就放心在前面冲，朕在后面给你补刀就是了，有朕在，没人能伤得了你……炎文帝在心头暗暗补充道。　　唐逸当时人都麻了，你大爷的，这还不准我有意见了是吧？　　逼急了信不信我造反去！　　“父皇放心，唐逸没意见。”　　萧棣赶紧跑过来，冲着唐逸摇了摇头。　　兄弟，别挣扎了，这就是我爹，他就是个老阴批，你反抗不了的。　　太子看到萧棣和唐逸关系这么好，眸色骤然一沉，唐逸是皇帝最看重的人，也是名动京都的小诗仙，他要是投靠萧棣，终归是个麻烦。　　不行，唐逸不能落在萧棣手中，必须将他拉过来！　　他当即走了出来，拱手道：“父皇，儿臣觉得……”　　“你觉得个屁，滚远点，朕看到你碍眼！”炎文帝一个冷眼瞪了过去，太子的话戛然而止。　　朕给过你机会的，你珍惜了吗？　　现在唐逸好不容易和老四磨合得还不错，你少给朕捣乱。　　否则，看朕怎么收拾你！　　而太子整个人都不好了，父皇竟然为了唐逸，众目睽睽之下打他的脸。　　父皇，到底谁是你亲生的？　　“好了，琐事解决了，现在解决正事。”　　炎文帝背着双手，看向唐逸道：“开始你的表演吧！今日参赛的可都是大炎骄子，各国高才，还有你三元及第的状元大哥！”　　“你要是胜了，朕准你提任何一个条件。”　　炎文帝拉着唐逸的手，直接向着高台走去。　　唐逸嘴角都在抽搐，这真是皇帝吗？怎么和前几日见到的萧策不一样啊！　　这个皇帝很不正经。　　还准我提任何一个条件？　　那我让你退位给我，行不行？　　两人上了舞台，炎文帝抓住唐逸的手高高扬起：“这，就是朕的小诗仙，我大炎内外所有大儒才子，谁敢来战？”　　“战胜他，你们也可以和朕提一个条件！”
content_en: Liu Zhou thought that Tang Yi would not dare to go too far and would help him plead with the emperor for his low profile and in full public view.After all, Tang Yi didn't dare to offend the Liu family!Tang Yi looked up at Liu Zhou, huh?Threaten me?Before I traveled through time, the foreign military’s research materials on me could fill a building.Am I afraid?Didn’t I kill them until they were scared?Not to mention your Liu family, it’s almost finished!"You won't let me go, you just don't want to die." Tang Yi took a few steps forward and approached Liu Zhou: "Enjoy it, thirty punishments plus a good meal, get through it... you can live for a few more days!" He really didn't want Liu Zhou to die like this!He usually likes to take matters into his own hands when it comes to revenge.After Shen Yuan's time, it was time to take over the old uncle's case and take action against the Liu family and his son.When Liu Zhou heard Tang Yi's words, he was so frightened that he fell to the ground and was dragged down by the Jin Yiwei.Liu Wen clenched her fists tightly, staring at Tang Yi, her eyes were red, as if oozing blood... Damn it, damn it, my son, please, that is your honor, how dare you refuse!You are looking for death, you are looking for death!Liu Wen roared in his heart, but he didn't dare to say a word.Just now, he told Tang Jing that Liu Zhou was young and frivolous. Would he dare to say the same thing to the emperor now?He doesn’t dare!If you are wrong, you have to admit it.He could only blame Tang Yi for all his hatred and anger.Liu Wen said nothing, and no one in the audience dared to speak.Tang Hua was called Brother Tang one by one by Liu Zhou. They usually had a close relationship, but at this time he was hiding far away, with his head almost hidden in his crotch.He was afraid that Liu Zhou would ask him for help.The children of Liuzhou's aristocratic families are nothing more than pawns to him.Since it is a chess piece, be prepared to be discarded at any time.Besides, it was their honor to be able to use Tang Hua as his chess piece."Liu Wen, you don't have to look at me like this. Soon, you will be reunited with your son." Tang Yi saw Liu Wen staring at him with cold eyes, shrugged and said, "Besides, this day won't be too long, no more than ten days. It's time for your Liu family to say goodbye to Kyoto." Everyone looked at Tang Yi in shock. Is this a direct declaration of war on the Minister of Household Affairs?He, a small member of the Imperial Guards, dared to declare war directly with the powerful Minister of Household Affairs?Is he crazy?When Emperor Yan Wen heard Tang Yi's words, the smile on his lips became even thicker. He is truly worthy of being my favorite son-in-law. With this domineering attitude, well, I was right."Liu Aiqing, this little brat looks down on you so much, what do you say?" Emperor Yanwen was in high spirits, let's make a fuss, let's make a fuss, the more fun the better.If you don’t make trouble, how can I fish in troubled waters?"Okay, I'll wait!" Liu Wen stared at Tang Yi and gritted his teeth."Okay, then I will be a witness for you." Emperor Yanwen clapped his hands and immediately put his hands on his hips and pointed at Tang Yi: "Tang Yi said that within ten days, all of you guys who don't pay back the money will be asked to pay back the money obediently, and even the principal."If you can't do it, he'll cut off his head to thank the world.""If you do, you have to tell him: Mr. Tang, I was wrong!""Do you have any objections?"Tang Yi suddenly raised his head, his face full of shock.My special mother!I didn’t say it!The Dog Emperor wants to harm me.When a group of ministers heard this, they all looked at Emperor Yanwen and almost jumped in anger.Your Majesty, do you really think we are blind and deaf?Tang Yi didn't say it, it was you who said it!You are forcing hatred!Uh, no... Soon, Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and other ministers' eyes lit up after they came to their senses. They must know that the account books they used to borrow money from the Ministry of Revenue had been destroyed and no longer existed.Tang Yi wants them to pay back the money within ten days. Is it possible?It's simply impossible!Thinking about it this way, didn't the emperor give his favorite little poetry fairy to them to kill?Thinking of this, all the ministers suddenly became excited."I have no objection, I have no objections." "Humph, you arrogant kid, I want to see what you are capable of." "Your Majesty, don't worry, I will not let this kid be arrogant!" "..." Tang Yi listened to these murderous comments, his face as dark as the bottom of a pot.If you want to borrow my sword, at least you should ask me if I agree first. Taking it without telling me is stealing... Tang Yi looked at Emperor Yanwen and said solemnly: "Your Majesty, I have an objection!" "No, you have no objection." Emperor Yanwen shook his head."I can have it!" Tang Yi gritted his teeth."You didn't!" Emperor Yan Wen raised his hand and patted Tang Yi on the shoulder, saying: "I am optimistic about you. Today you can crush the entire court with your own power." "Within ten days, you can also use your own power to suppress the civil and military forces of the entire dynasty." "I, believe in your own vision." Vision is not important, the main thing is that I need a knife to split the haze that hangs over Dayan.And this knife needs to be sharpened by me myself, so you can just charge in front and I will touch up the knife for you from behind. With me here, no one can hurt you... Emperor Yanwen secretly added in his heart.Tang Yi was all numb at the time. It's your uncle's fault. I'm not allowed to have any opinions on this, right?Believe it or not, I will rebel if I get desperate!"Father, don't worry, Tang Yi has no objection." Xiao Di hurried over and shook his head at Tang Yi.Brother, stop struggling, this is my dad, he is just a bastard, you can’t resist.When the prince saw that Xiao Di and Tang Yi had such a good relationship, his eyes suddenly darkened. Tang Yi was the most valued person by the emperor and a famous poet in Kyoto. If he took refuge with Xiao Di, it would be trouble after all.No, Tang Yi cannot fall into Xiao Di's hands, he must be pulled over!He immediately walked out, cupped his hands and said: "Father, I think..." "You think you are stupid, get away, I see you are an eyesore!" Emperor Yanwen glared at him coldly, and the prince's words stopped abruptly.I gave you the opportunity, have you cherished it?Now that Tang Yi and Lao Si are getting along well, please stop causing trouble for me.Otherwise, see how I deal with you!The prince was in bad shape, and his father actually slapped him in the face in front of everyone for Tang Yi.Father, who is your biological child?"Okay, the trivial matters have been solved, now let's get down to business." Emperor Yanwen clasped his hands behind his back and looked at Tang Yi and said, "Start with your expression.
